supersession_reason: The referee must-fixes were closed, the historical-scope paragraph was softened to a knowledge statement, the singled-out Kopp discussion was removed, and the deterministic manuscript and companion archive were rebuilt.

repairs.abstract: The proved CM route list is e=2,6,8, and the higher-order theorem is summarized as five order-six packets, two quartic packets, and one order-ten packet.
repairs.equations: All manual equation tags were removed; labels and eqref now determine a collision-free sequence.
repairs.conventions: The L-function Fourier convention, inverse transform, Artin action, and compatible quartic generators are fixed explicitly and cited by Engines A and C.
repairs.height_places: Zero-radius places are paired through the exact ray-field isomorphism, so the candidate and powered analytic invariant have modulus one at the same nonsplit embedding.
repairs.voutier: The manuscript cites the main theorem on page 82 and states its degree range d>=2.
repairs.engine_a_degeneracy: An exact 1,560-case replay found 672 zero Euler products among 2,232 supported character occurrences, affecting 603 rows; all supported terms vanish in 346 rows.
repairs.proof_completion: The manuscript explicitly identifies the seven Section 4 Engine-B rows plus the RQ-000458 proof as the proof of the selected higher-order theorem.
repairs.historical_scope: The paper says only that the authors are not aware of previous unconditional one-place packet identifications at support orders six or ten and states that the observation plays no role in the proofs.
